subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is becoming a priority as fabrication approaches. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving. It is not clear whether this reflects a real design decision that needs interpreting, or just a documentation error that should be corrected without changing intent.
